    - /paperless-ngx
repositories:
  - path: ssh://backup@nas.${SECRET_DEFAULT_DOMAIN}//opt/local/paperless-ngx
    label: onsite
    append_only: true
    make_parent_directories: true
  - path: ssh://backup@nas.${SECRET_OFFSITE_DOMAIN}//opt/backup/paperless-ngx
    label: offsite
    append_only: true
    make_parent_directories: true

archive_name_format: paperless-ngx-{now}
